title: Thunder's leadership book (coordinated by Cris Pop), The Voice: lead by listening and making space, not performing
summary: The chapter argues that a leader's voice is not a tool of persuasion or performance but a presence that comes from inner work, honesty and responsibility. It says the strongest voice belongs to the listener, and that leaders should make space for others' ideas rather than be the source of all wisdom. Andreea Popa closes with her own story of seeing, at Thunder, leadership reframed as service rather than dominance.

principles.text: Voice comes from alignment and honesty, not polish; vulnerability signals you speak from what matters.
principles.quote: When your words match your life, people feel that. When there’s alignment between who you are and what you’re saying, humans naturally lean in.

principles.text: Leadership is earning trust so people can bring you their fragile things, not commanding the room.
principles.quote: The work here is not learning how to command a room but to become the kind of human others trust with their fragile things.

principles.text: Listening fully makes you the center of gravity; invite rather than interrupt.
principles.quote: Don’t interrupt, invite. Don’t compete for space, create it.

principles.text: Earn attention by giving it first; trust grows in the pauses where others' thoughts land.
principles.quote: Earn attention by giving it first. The most respected voices are built on trust, and people listen to those who have made them feel truly heard.

principles.text: Use your voice to make people feel more capable, helping them trust their own judgment.
principles.quote: The most powerful thing you can do with your voice is make people feel more capable of handling their challenges, not less.

principles.text: Don't be the source of all wisdom; recognize good ideas in others and help them connect.
principles.quote: Stop trying to be the source of all wisdom. Start being the person who recognizes wisdom when you hear it and encourages others to spread it.
